# Cncf Podman Desktop Reviewer

Review Podman Desktop using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. An open-source tool for developers to work with containers and Kubernetes with an intuitive and user-friendly interface to effortlessly build, manage, and deploy containers and Kubernetes — all from the desktop.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
